4a07f405b32fa2f6.description:
Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere. Our AI-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.
We are seeking native Punjabi speakers with strong English comprehension to join our global linguistic community as Freelance Linguistic Testers. No prior testing experience is required—we provide full training! If you own a modern Mac and have a sharp eye for detail, this is your opportunity to work on cutting-edge IT and AI projects.
Position Overview

• 
Language Pair: English to Punjabi

• 
Domain: Information Technology, Software, and AI Content

• 
Experience: No previous linguistic testing experience required. Training and guidelines will be provided.

• 
Hardware Requirement: Must own a Mac device with an M-series chip (M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer). Note: This is an absolute technical requirement for our secure testing environment.

Responsibilities
As an Punjabi Linguistic Tester, you will:

• 
Perform Linguistic QA: Review and refine AI-generated and localized Punjabi content to ensure natural flow and cultural accuracy.

• 
Software & UI Testing: Navigate applications to identify layout issues, truncated text, and functional bugs in the Punjabi interface.

• 
Bug Reporting: Document and report linguistic and technical errors clearly in English using our testing guidelines.

Requirements
To be considered for this role, candidates must meet the following technical, linguistic, and professional criteria:

• 
Linguistic Proficiency: Native-level fluency in written and spoken Punjabi, paired with professional-level English comprehension and written communication skills.

• 
Hardware Specification (Mandatory): Active access to a Mac computer equipped with an Apple Silicon M-series chip (M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer).

• 
Cultural Competency: A strong, intuitive grasp of modern Punjabi cultural nuances, localized language trends, and regional idiomatic expressions.

• 
Technical Aptitude: Comfort navigating new software interfaces, adhering to detailed testing guidelines, and reporting technical/linguistic bugs clearly in English.

• 
Work Environment: A reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote, independent contract work.

• 
Attention to Quality: Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to consistently identify minor grammatical, formatting, and user-interface (UI) errors.

• 
Professional Experience: No prior experience in linguistic testing or translation is required; however, candidates must be willing and able to complete the mandatory onboarding training.

Benefits
• 
Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.

• 
Long-Term Collaboration Opportunities: We aim to build lasting partnerships with our freelance linguists; successful candidates will become part of our preferred talent pool for ongoing, periodic project assignments.

• 
Cutting-Edge Tech: Gain experience working with advanced localization workflows, AI-driven translation tools, and global brand content.

• 
Elite Projects: Build your portfolio by working on software utilized by millions of global users daily.

4a12702248c8fe95.description: Job Description Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance. You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong. Job Title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer

Locations: Bangalore

Reports to: Director

A quick snapshot…

As Sr. Machine Learning Engineer, you will Develop and optimize machine learning solutions by designing, implementing, and fine-tuning functionality for performance, scalability, and efficiency in production. The other responsibilities include data processing, feature engineering, developing, evaluating, and tuning models for optimal run-time performance.

Why it’s a big deal… 

This role is important as it balances technical implementation with project leadership, leading small to medium-sized initiatives while owning specific components in a Machine Learning solution.

Are you the person we’re looking for? 

Experience. You must have more than 5 years of experience and atleast 2+ years of experience in data science, software development, or data engineering. You are also good in AI model development, training, scoring, and deployment

Optimization. You are good at ML solutions, especially in Machine Learning and optimizing it by designing (25%), implementing, and fine-tuning functionality for performance, scalability, and efficiency in production.

Collaboration. You are good in collaborate on integration and infrastructure by working with engineers to deploy modules, assist with platform upgrades, and enhance automated testing for reliability (25%)

Documentation. You know how to document and support development through detailed technical documentation to ensure clarity and continuity for future enhancement (25%)

Cross functional support. You provide technical support and training to Sales, Implementation, and Support teams

Participation. You will actively participate in code reviews, ensuring that code quality standards are met and that any issues are addressed promptly (10%)

Education. A bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent

Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…

Proficiency. You are proficient in Python programming, Manage ML Libraries and TensorFlow, PyTorch, XgBoost, Scikit-learn, Spark ML and code/model versioning in Git, MLFlow.

Platforms. You have worked on Cloud computing platforms like Azure,databricks and know well to work on data analytics tool like Spark and Pandas.

Knowledge and understanding. You have good understanding of software testing, benchmarking, and continuous integration with experience in model management, data versioning, maintaining and orchestrating pipelines. You also know distributed computing and have knowledge of advanced machine learning and AI models such as Neural Network models.

Good to have. It is good if you demonstrate a strong understanding of core AI concepts, terminology, and practical applications. Regularly applies AI tools to improve task execution and decision-making, with growing awareness of ethical implications and responsible use.

Additional certification. Certifications in specialized areas like Natural Language Processing and Recommender systems Azure AI Engineer certification will be an added advantage.

Did we pique your interest? 

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you! 

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?  

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement 

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview
Harvey is building the infrastructure foundation behind one of the most ambitious AI product companies in the world. Our Core Infrastructure team powers every user interaction across Harvey’s legal AI platform, which already processes billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests for leading law firms, enterprises, and other high-stakes customers.
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Core Infrastructure from Bengaluru as we scale the platform, the team, and the next generation of Harvey products. This is a high-leverage role for a builder-leader who can grow strong engineers, drive technical execution, and raise the bar on reliability, performance, security, and developer velocity.
This is not a pure operations role. Core Infrastructure at Harvey is responsible for building new systems as well as hardening existing ones, with an emphasis on architecture, scale, and long-term platform leverage rather than reactive firefighting alone.
Harvey is in a build era, not a maintenance era. New product surfaces ship rapidly, and India engineering is expected to play a foundational role in shaping the architecture, culture, and roadmap of Harvey’s next decade.

At Harvey, we value Decisiveness, Simplicity, and the mindset that Job's Not Finished. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

Why This Role Matters:
Core Infrastructure exists to “deliver core infrastructure that powers our products and teams,” and its current mission is operational excellence at scale. The team serves two critical user groups: external customers who need Harvey to be as reliable as the tools it replaces, and internal product engineering teams who need infrastructure they can build on without firefighting.
The systems this team owns are directly tied to Harvey’s next wave of growth, including agent infrastructure, database resilience, site reliability, vector search, job execution, regional data residency, and multi-cloud scale.

What You'll Do:
• 
Lead, hire, and develop a high-agency infrastructure team in Bengaluru, creating a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and strong mentorship.
• 
Own delivery for core infrastructure investments spanning cloud infrastructure, observability, container orchestration, reliability, and platform foundations.
• 
Partner closely with Product Engineering, Security, and adjacent platform teams so infrastructure accelerates product delivery instead of constraining it.
• 
Guide technical strategy across multi-cloud infrastructure, including Azure- and GCP-based systems, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, container management, and infrastructure as code.
• 
Drive operational excellence through better observability, incident response, disaster recovery, runbooks, alerting, and recovery tooling.
• 
Help the organization scale safely by improving system design quality, hardening critical paths, and pushing durable solutions to reliability bottlenecks before they become customer-facing failures.
• 
Partner with AI and product teams to support Harvey’s next major product surfaces, including agent workflows, model infrastructure, and large-scale document processing systems.
• 
Contribute as a hands-on technical leader when needed, especially in architecture reviews, incident leadership, prioritization, and high-stakes cross-functional programs.

Representative Problems You May Lead:
• 
Hardening the Agent Platform so product teams can ship AI agent experiences with resource isolation, authenticated sandbox access, and resilient execution.
• 
Improving database resilience and recovery so incidents are mitigated quickly and the main database never becomes the bottleneck during critical events.
• 
Raising site reliability through stronger alerting, failover strategy, autoscaling, and runbooks so customers are never the first to know Harvey is degraded.
• 
Scaling vector and retrieval infrastructure that underpins document-heavy workflows and enterprise search, including migrations that improve reliability and unlock new capabilities.
• 
Building a multi-region, enterprise-grade platform that meets strict data residency, security, and uptime expectations for global customers.

What We’re Looking For:
• 
4+ years of engineering management experience and 10+ years of hands-on infrastructure or platform engineering experience in production environments.
• 
Deep technical strength across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform or Pulumi.
• 
A track record of designing and scaling reliable distributed systems, with strong judgment around performance, fault tolerance, and operational tradeoffs.
• 
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and translating ambiguous platform needs into clear execution plans and measurable outcomes.
• 
Strong people leadership: hiring well, coaching engineers, creating accountability, and building a healthy, high-performing team culture.
• 
Clear communication and calm execution during incidents, escalations, and high-stakes customer-impacting situations.
• 
A systems mindset, bias for simplicity, and the ability to raise standards while keeping teams moving fast.

Nice to Have
• 
Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, high-throughput inference systems, or model platform reliability.
• 
Experience operating multi-tenant, security-sensitive platforms for enterprise or regulated customers.
• 
Familiarity with Azure at scale; GCP or AWS experience also transfers well.
• 
Experience supporting global, follow-the-sun operations or building teams across regions.

Additional Information
• 
Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
